Blinky 1.5.15

  • 自动安装会在下载完成后安装并重新打开 Blinky。 在「设置 → 关于 → 发现更新时」选择「自动安装」后，定时检查会下载更新、安装，并重新打开 Blinky，不必先退出。现在检查仍会打开更新窗口。 #76
  • 打开主窗口后，Blinky 成为最前面的应用。 用量卡片上的四格图标、Dock，以及从启动台或 Spotlight 启动，都会让菜单栏显示 Blinky。 #76
  • 在 Token 窗口外点击会关闭它。 Esc 和关闭按钮仍可关闭。点击窗口自己的菜单不会关闭。 #76
  • Token 窗口一次只列出一种划分。 先是 Token 活动，然后是使用节奏，再是划分方式菜单，可选按模型、按 Agent、按项目或按会话。新安装默认按模型，这个选择会被记住。使用节奏的数字在整行均匀排列。Token 合计和下面的费用估算居中。「未读取到用量」仍在，字号更小、颜色更淡。 #76
  • 智谱和 z.ai 会显示 5 小时重置券和每周重置券。 用量卡片分别列出这两种券，方式和 Codex 列出额度重置券相同，并写出还剩几张。 #76
  • 使用重置券前会先确认。 在 Codex、智谱或 z.ai 的用量卡片上，点使用只是询问，确认之后才会用掉一张。 #76

在 GitHub 查看更新说明

Blinky 1.5.15

  • Install silently installs and relaunches. With Settings → About → When an update is found set to Install silently, a scheduled check downloads the update, installs it, and opens Blinky again, without waiting for Blinky to quit. Check now still opens the update window. #76
  • Opening the main window makes Blinky the frontmost app. The grid icon on the usage card, the Dock, and a launch from Launchpad or Spotlight put Blinky's name in the menu bar. #76
  • The Token window closes when you click outside it. Escape and the close button still close it. A click on its menu does not. #76
  • The Token window lists one breakdown at a time. Token activity comes first, then the usage rhythm, then a menu for By model, By agent, By project, or By session. A new install starts on By model, and the choice is remembered. The rhythm's figures spread across the row. The token total and the estimate under it are centered. "No usage data read" stays, in smaller secondary type. #76
  • Zhipu and z.ai show 5-hour and weekly reset cards. The usage card lists each kind the way Codex lists limit reset credits, including how many are left. #76
  • A reset card is used only after you confirm. On the Codex, Zhipu, or z.ai usage card, Use asks first and spends one card only when you confirm. #76
